description: This file defines the 'WithId' interface, which is used for objects associated with an entity identified by an EntityId. It includes a deprecated method getId() that returns the entity's ID as a String, and a preferred method getEntityId() returning an EntityId object.

classes.name: WithId
classes.description: An interface indicating an object associated with an entity identified by EntityId, providing methods to retrieve that ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID as a String. This method is deprecated and the preferred method is getEntityId().

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the EntityId object representing the entity's identifier.
